answers.1:
kubectl create ingress web-ing -n $NS --rule="app.example.com/=web:80"
kubectl get ingress web-ing -n $NS

# rule 형식은 호스트/경로=서비스:포트
answers.2:
kubectl create ingress api-ing -n $NS --rule="app.example.com/api*=web:80"
kubectl get ingress api-ing -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.rules[0].http.paths[0].pathType}'

# 끝의 * 가 Prefix 를 뜻한다. 없으면 Exact
answers.3:
kubectl create service externalname db -n $NS --external-name=db.example.com
kubectl get svc db -n $NS

# TYPE 이 ExternalName, EXTERNAL-IP 칸에 도메인이 보인다
answers.4:
kubectl expose deployment web -n $NS --name=web-np --type=NodePort --port=80
kubectl get svc web-np -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}' > /tmp/q4.txt
cat /tmp/q4.txt

# PORT(S) 칸의 80:3xxxx/TCP 에서 뒤의 값이 노드 포트
answers.5:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: hapod}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  hostAliases:
  - ip: "10.9.8.7"
    hostnames: ["cache.local"]
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/hapod -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec hapod -n $NS -- cat /etc/hosts

# kubelet 이 /etc/hosts 를 관리하므로 컨테이너 안에서 직접 고친 것은 재시작하면 사라진다
answers.6:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dapod
  labels: {app: demo}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - {name: info, mountPath: /etc/podinfo}
  volumes:
  - name: info
    downwardAPI:
      items:
      - path: labels
        fieldRef: {fieldPath: metadata.labels}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/dapod -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec dapod -n $NS -- cat /etc/podinfo/labels

# 파일에는 app="demo" 형태로 한 줄씩 들어 있다
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata: {name: secpod}
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sleep", "3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - {name: sec, mountPath: /etc/sec}
  volumes:
  - name: sec
    secret:
      secretName: db-pass
      defaultMode: 0400
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/secpod -n $NS --timeout=90s
kubectl exec secpod -n $NS -- stat -L -c %a /etc/sec/pw

# 기본 0644 → 0400. 컨테이너가 다른 사용자로 돌면 읽지 못하므로 fsGroup 과 함께 설계한다
answers.8:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata: {name: kv}
spec:
  serviceName: kv
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: kv}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: kv}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 0
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.25
        volumeMounts:
        - {name: data, mountPath: /data}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata: {name: data}
    spec:
      accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
      resources:
        requests: {storage: 100Mi}
EOF
kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod/kv-0 -n $NS --timeout=120s
kubectl get pvc -n $NS

# PVC 이름 = data-kv-0. StatefulSet 을 지워도 PVC 는 남으므로 따로 지워야 한다
answers.9:
kubectl patch cronjob tick -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}'
kubectl get cronjob tick -n $NS -o jsonpath='{.spec.concurrencyPolicy}'

# 오래 걸리는 배치가 겹쳐 쌓이는 것을 막을 때 Forbid
